plans.name: Pay as you go – AI Voice Agents
Pay as you go – AI Chat Agents

notes: The page does not list a plan setup fee. The only one-time fee is "One-time $10 fee" (line 703), which appears to go with Verified Phone Number. That item is also listed at $10.00/Phone number/month (lines 566 and 702). The same pay-as-you-go voice range "$0.07-$0.31/minute" also appears in the comparison table (line 227). The page lists no included minutes. Pay as you go includes 20 free concurrent calls (lines 117, 230, 560). Extra concurrency costs $8.00/Concurrency/month (lines 561, 697, 728). Concurrency Burst costs +$0.10/min (line 450). Monthly items: Retell Phone Numbers $2.00/month (lines 555, 691). Retell SMS $20.00/month (lines 558, 694). Knowledge Base $8.00/Knowledge Base/month. Conflicts on the page: (1) Knowledge Base is described as "$80/month free value (10 KBs)" and "(prorated)" at lines 563-564, but as "Free for first 10 knowledge bases" at lines 699-700. (2) Enterprise concurrency is "High Cap on Concurrent Calls" at line 132, "No Cap on Concurrent Calls" at line 231, and "custom concurrency starting at 50+ calls" at line 728. (3) The cost estimator's LLM list (lines 141-159: GPT 5.5, GPT 5.4, etc.) doesn't match the component pricing tables (GPT 6.x, Claude 5.x, Gemini 4, etc.). (4) The estimator shows a total of $0.11 labeled "per month" (lines 210-213), but its parts add up to a per-minute cost ($0.04 LLM + $0.055 voice infra + $0.015 TTS). (5) The Chat Agent Pricing and Monthly Subscription sections appear twice (lines 451-566 and 587-703). The component rates vary: Retell Voice Infra $0.055/minute; TTS $0.015 to $0.10/minute; telephony $0.015/min shown by default and no charge for SIP trunking/custom telephony; add-ons such as Knowledge Base +$0.005/minute, Batch Call +$0.005/dial, Branded Call +$0.10/outbound call, and AI QA $0.10/min after the first 100 free minutes.

free_trial.text: Go live in minutes with $10 in free credits.
